`architecture_meeting.txt` is used by unit/integration tests as stand-in
transcript text (no audio decoding needed).

`sample_meeting.wav`, referenced in docs/TEST_PLAN.md's manual "smoke
test real", is intentionally not committed here -- supply your own short
English technical-audio clip locally on the target Mac when running that
manual step. Keeping it out of the repo avoids ever committing anything
that looks like real meeting audio, consistent with docs/PRIVACY.md.
